title: H20: hub proxies keyMaterial; requester needs canAddParticipant
description: protocol-06 §3.3 leaves the hub's check undefined. In .6 the hub only proxies keyMaterial for hosted rooms with remote targets (local serving is .7/.12.3) and requires the requester to be a participant holding canAddParticipant. wg item filed. Chosen (plan recommendation approved by Mark 2026-10-18).
